_comment: ADR-012 P4 push target: a REMOTE PBS this cluster PUSHES its VM backups to. Used by a remote-only/single-node site (no local PBS), or as an extra off-site copy. Copy to /home/tappaas/config/push-<name>.json, edit, then: backup-manage.sh add-push <name>. The REMOTE side runs `add-external <thissite>` to grant our authId the DatastoreBackup role (write, no delete) on <namespace> and owns prune/retention/immutability — so a compromise here cannot erase the off-site copy (ADR-012 §3.5). The password + fingerprint are prompted at onboarding, NEVER stored here.
name: offsite
retentionNote: Retention is OWNED BY THE REMOTE (we hold write-no-delete and cannot prune). Set it on the remote's add-external for <thissite>.
